stories.title: Chainalysis says breach exposed credentials for all customers
stories.summary: Blockchain intelligence firm Chainalysis says a recent attack on its systems and internal tools has exposed credentials and live tokens for all customers.

stories.title: Chainalysis Breach Exposes All Users' Credentials, Forces Shutdown of Key Services

stories.title: Experts Demonstrate Barracuda Email Security Gateway Chain Enabling Root Access Without Login
stories.summary: Two flaws in Barracuda's Email Security Gateway, an email-filtering appliance, can be chained to run commands on it as root, its highest level of access, with no login required. The company released patches on Monday, and the security firm watchTowr detailed…

Meghan Markle's father arrested in US over child sex abuse images
stories.summary: Eighty-two-year-old Thomas Markle, who is estranged from his daughter, was charged with one count of 'possession of child pornography' and is to make an initial court appearance in Tampa on Friday, US Attorney Bill Essayli said in a statement.

stories.title: EU tells TikTok to change 'harmful' For You feed
stories.summary: The European Union warned that TikTok's recommendation system exposes children and vulnerable individuals to potentially damaging content by pushing a stream of videos similar to those the user has previously engaged with. TikTok rejected the accusations.

stories.title: Europe: What we know about the hoax bomb threats disrupting flights
stories.summary: Dozens of European flights have been disrupted this week after bomb threats were sent in to various airports, with fighter planes escorting many civilian aircraft after threats were called in mid-flight.

stories.title: Coach who helped Sinner to the top set to depart
stories.summary: The coach who helped guide Jannik Sinner to five Grand Slam titles and the world number one spot is to leave the player's camp at the end of the year.

kev.name: Apple Multiple Products Improper Authentication Vulnerability
kev.summary: Apple iOS, iPadOS, macOS, Safari, tvOS and watchOS 10.5 contain an improper authentication vulnerability which could allow an attacker with arbitrary read and write capability to bypass pointer authentication.

entries.title: The leak didn't move the date
entries.body: Rockstar ran its Netflix Extended Look on 27 August as planned, and 19 November still stands. Take-Two, meanwhile, has served DMCA subpoenas on Microsoft, Discord, X and Google chasing the handle CyberLeek.

entries.title: Someone is counter-programming launch day
entries.body: Devolver Digital has a mystery game dated 19 November. Pre-orders have been open since June: Standard $79.99, Ultimate $99.99, no special edition.
